purpose: Research source register and contextual observations, not an activated population or business-evidence pack
notes: Only primary author, publisher and government sources are included. Abstract-only access is identified; article summaries do not establish local validation.
Declared authorship, official host, byte fingerprints, statistical transcription and research validity are separate checks. A hash is not source certification.
All current five-layer persona fields are scenario assumptions. Context observations are not automatically assigned to residents or used as prevalence weights.
Unknown data remain null, not zero. Geography identifiers are internal; polygon boundaries and cross-year crosswalks have not been verified here.
This addition does not change frozen submission files, the active population pack, or previously archived original documents.
